_comment: MVS mode: verify NFS results over MVS FTP. Copy to config.json and edit. Field notes are in README.md.

nfs._mount_point_note: The location where the NFS export is mounted, and the ONLY place the tests operate. On Linux a directory path (e.g. /mnt/dinonfs); on Windows the NFS drive letter (e.g. "Z:\\").

_ftp_dialect_note: How a dataset is named. true/true/'' = CWD 'DSN' then RETR MEMBER (z/OS convention). false/false/'/' = CWD /DSN -- the path form mvs_upload.expect uses, and the one to try if reads work but STOR is refused. use_cwd=false = RETR 'DSN(MEMBER)' with no CWD. Run 'run_tests.py --config config.json --probe-ftp': it tests each form for BOTH read and write and prints the config line to paste.
_ftp_note: Leave user/password null and set the MVS_USERID and MVS_PASSWORD environment variables instead (do not put credentials in this file).
